title: Scoped signing key templates can bypass required proxy authentication
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports scoped signing keys and authorization callouts that assign user permissions and connection restrictions. A user can be required to connect through an authenticated proxy.

### Problem Description

The server did not consistently enforce the proxy requirement after applying a scoped signing key template. A user whose effective template required a proxy could establish a direct connection without the expected proxy authentication. Both direct JWT authentication and authorization callouts were affected.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-2wxw-wgx7-4ffx>
